doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

title: Opening: Times-Picayune article and small talk
summary: Russell, Laine and Mrs. Laine look at a newspaper clipping and chat; Laine talks about a parade the day before.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Let's get down which issue this is. That's May the 15th, just last week, isn't it? Yeah. Yeah, I didn't get that. Times-Picayune. Yeah, Times-Picayune Sunday, May 15th. I wouldn't have knew it either. My daughter told me. In the amusement section.
Yeah, she said to me, did you see the... I said, no. She said, well, you... and I come back...
That same old instrument was in the First War.
She said, well, you're on the back of your radio program. She said, it's on the next page. So that's how I come and I got it. He didn't know nothing about it either.
No, I wouldn't have known nothing about it. The only time I get a chance to look at the paper when I've not got any... My hats are soaking and they're getting dry. Then I have a little time.
That's... They're fine with me. How was the parade yesterday?
